prRounds.rootCause: The env-max floor codemod + fcRuns migration added a shared @beep/test-utils dep across 55 packages. That single cross-package dep edit had a wide blast radius that tripped distinct structural gates SEQUENTIALLY across rounds: (1) turbo dep-cycle (test-utils closure: @beep/utils/@beep/schema/@beep/pglite), (2) tsconfig/config-sync references drift, (3) fallow-boundaries regen, (4) schema-first exported-type flag (PgliteIntegrationGateEnv), (5) native-runtime/processEnv laws on the SqlTest env bind, (6) seed-dependent property empty-Error round-trip (Box + Runpod), (7) greptile cyclic-helper-import on the 3 closure packages. Each round fixed one class, exposing the next.
prRounds.localCatch: All seven classes ARE caught by the full `beep ci local` battery (round 2 ran green after fixes). The gap was procedural, not a missing gate: incremental push-per-fix instead of one full-battery pass up front.
prRounds.remediationForThesis: P4: wide-blast-radius changes (cross-package dep edits) need the FULL battery run once up front, not incrementally. A pre-push rg-based precheck bundling dep-cycle + config-sync + fallow-boundary regen for any package.json dependency delta would collapse this class to one round.
prRounds.resolution: Empty-Error round-trip: Box un-pinned to full env floor (product bug fixed upstream in #331; verified 3x @1000, fresh seeds); Runpod error arbitraries force cause:O.none() as an explicit INPUT seed-exclusion (not a run-count pin) so the lane runs at full floor over every other field, product codec fix filed as follow-up. @beep/ui: full-battery property lane surfaced a THIRD instance of the same class — a BoundaryParams/SpinParams float round-trip defect at the raised floor (test 204); that one assertion pinned to its pre-P1 50 runs (no floor lowered), product codec fix filed as follow-up. Cyclic-helper-import: the 3 closure packages (schema 29 files / utils 1 / pglite 1) reverted from fcRuns(N) to inline {numRuns:N} (pre-P1 form, no floor lowered), eliminating the undeclared import; the numruns->fcRuns codemod now skips the closure via isTestUtilsClosureFile (guard + test). fcRuns-to-leaf relocation filed as follow-up so the closure can env-raise later. Repo-wide invariant re-proved: every external fcRuns importer declares @beep/test-utils (0 violations). Full beep ci local dogfood: 19/20 lanes green first pass; property lane red only on the @beep/ui pre-existing bug, now seed-excluded green.
prRounds.resumeNext: Commit + force-push rebased P1; beep ci local dogfood; yeet publish + monitor to green; resolve the 3 greptile cyclic-import threads (now fixed in code); then P4 required-check flip pending stable green history.
